reason: Explorer requires the same current Auth and People eligibility intersection that Gateway uses. People rejects hcm.utility, and Auth also sends the owner-bound ORIGINATING_COMMAND_SCOPE receipt profile to generic People eligibility even though only the sealed owner receipt can resolve it. Platform cannot prove Gateway hcm-scope, psr or canonical population evidence from Auth alone.

predecessorAuthority.rule: R1, R2 and R3 remain binding. R4 changes only the exact People authority audience/utility SELF boundary, Platform parity semantics, canonical population seal and exporter-test closure.

backend.rule: Continue the same uncommitted implementation. Do not create another worktree, branch, migration or replacement adapter.

frontend.rule: R4 grants no new frontend path authority. Finish only unresolved R1/R2 frontend acceptance gaps with smallest owner verification.

authorizedSuccessorWork: Add hcm.utility exact SELF eligibility to the existing People HCM adapter without accepting personal or other surface selectors.
Permit exactly dwp-gateway and dwp-platform-server on the existing People eligibility endpoint with exact token and identity header validation.

Skip generic People eligibility only for route.hcm.utility.explorer-command-receipt.data when its selected platform-origin grant is hcm.command-receipt.view with ORIGINATING_COMMAND_SCOPE; preserve prior eligibility behavior for every other route.

Within the existing Explorer package/config scope, compose current Auth and People evidence, reproduce Gateway scope intersection and decision-revision semantics, and fail closed on drift or unavailability.
Track current request-route and per-origin-route psr separately for receipt reconciliation.

Derive a distinct internal canonical shared-receipt authority digest server-side from the trusted current hcm-scope while preserving the public/legacy receipt digest, replay behavior and historical rows.
Retain the existing SYS-012 exporter unit-test purpose assertions in the exact authorized test method.

verificationPolicy.backendRule: Run A1, P1 and M1 once each only after every R2/R3/R4 static blocker is closed. After a failure, rerun only the smallest owning test.
verificationPolicy.frontendRule: Do not rerun aggregate M2 or an already-successful frontend owner scope.
verificationPolicy.forbidden: No repository-wide suite, C1/C3 regeneration gate, second A1/P1/M1 aggregate, generated security carrier update or repeated successful stage.

completionGate: Gateway can authorize a valid hcm.utility SELF Explorer request through current People evidence.
Command-only packages can reach the owner PEP for the exact utility Explorer platform-origin receipt profile, but no receipt data is returned until the current sealed origin is re-proven.

Platform independently reproduces the current People-derived hcm-scope and psr for ordinary Explorer and explorer-origin routes; for the exact platform-origin receipt exception it instead validates the forwarded Auth source scope and People-free receipt-route psr, then separately proves the stored origin through Auth and People.
Descendant routes are evaluated on their own surfaces and unavailable owner evidence remains explicit PARTIAL or fail-closed as specified.
Preferences, recents, reference and navigation receipts compare the immutable origin psr to the current exact origin-route psr.
The new internal canonical authority digest is server-derived from trusted hcm-scope and cannot be changed by a forged browser digest header; the public receipt digest remains producer-compatible.
Legacy rows/replay remain unchanged and no historical backfill or second migration exists.
A1, P1, M1 and the remaining exact contract checks pass, then both module branches are committed, pushed, clean and upstream exact.
